1339-2921-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2921-7920.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4050-7435--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-3899-4544--106.easyPrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-3899-4544--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-3899-4544--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

1778-3661-5861-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3661-5861-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

141-2292-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-2292-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3240-5147-5477-6462.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token, a 1/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3258-3963-7417.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3258-3963-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Meneldor. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-3963-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

2366-3430-3499-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-3499-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

5344-6349-6650.easyPrerequisites:
You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5344-6349-6650.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

1003-2173-2981-5220.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

5220-5231-6538-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

856-2173-2511-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-2511-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-2511-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

339-677-2438-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

233-714-3983.description: When a land enters the battlefield, it becomes a Swamp due to Kormus Bell. This then causes it to become a 0/0 creature due to Urborg and Night of Souls' Betrayal, and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.

3490-4616-5231-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-4616-5231-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-1251-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

856-2279-3967-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2279-3967-4321.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

915-4131-5856.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

1698-2350-3260-3540.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-2350-3260-3540.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-2350-3260-3540.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

719-1238-2292-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

969-2388-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

567-1274-4186.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-1274-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1651-3263-5251.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token that is also an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

1645-2370-4050.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, attaching it to Bramble Elemental.
Bramble Elemental triggers, creating two 1/1  Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2743-3596.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other creatures.
2743-3596.description:
Cast Echoing Equation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing all creatures you control to become copies of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

3977-4191.description:
Cast Horned Kavu without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Horned Kavu enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

119-2757-3467.notablePrerequisites: Darksteel Garrison attached to an untapped basic land.
119-2757-3467.description:
Pay {G} and sacrifice Lifespark Spellbomb, targeting the fortified land.
Tap the fortified land with Earthcraft, untapping itself.
Darksteel Garrison triggers giving any creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

661-1329-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Sculpting Steel is a copy of Genesis Chamber.
Enough additional mana and/or artifacts on the battlefield to make up for Emry's command tax (if applicable).
661-1329-3169-4050.description:
Cast Emry by paying {U} plus commander tax (if applicable).
When Emry enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, Genesis Chamber, and the copy of Genesis Chamber.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve Emry's ability, milling four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Send Emry from the graveyard to the command zone as a state-based action.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times.

539-1616.description:
Cast Realm Razer by paying {3}{R}{G}{W}.
When Realm Razer enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, you may activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Realm Razer trigger, exiling all lands.
When Realm Razer leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

64-3617-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Warden of the Eye.
64-3617-4305.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
The Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
